summary: Iteration 19: Full testing of PIN-free quick login (POST /api/auth/login-quick) and Admin Panel scrolling fix. Backend 14/14 tests passed. All frontend UI tests verified via Playwright. All 8 specified features verified successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: SelectProfile.tsx polls /api/players every 4s (no auth header needed) — correct, /api/players is public endpoint
handleSelect skips loggingIn || onlineUsernames.has(username) — IN USE profiles are blocked at the JS level (not just CSS disabled), good defensive coding

TableAdmin has role='admin' in PROFILES array so clicking it calls navigate('/admin') — code path verified, TableAdmin was 'IN USE' during test so direct UI click to /admin could not be tested live, but code logic + API are correct

AdminPanel outer div: height:100dvh + overflow:hidden fix applied correctly. Main element has flex:1 + overflowY:auto so scroll works (scrollHeight=1125 > clientHeight=710 confirmed on mobile viewport)
loginQuick in AuthContext correctly calls /api/auth/login-quick (no pin param), sets localStorage chullz_token + chullz_user, and updates state
test_credentials: AceKing (tap card), CardShark (tap card), TableAdmin (tap card → /admin). No PIN needed.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. BluffMaster and TableAdmin remained online from previous iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 19 are working: PIN-free quick login via POST /api/auth/login-quick, all 7 profile cards shown with correct IN USE detection (polls /api/players every 4s), IN USE profiles are blocked (disabled='' + JS guard), Admin Panel has height:100dvh scrolling fix working (all 7 players visible, scrollable on both desktop and mobile). Direct TableAdmin card click → /admin flow could not be tested live because TableAdmin was IN USE, but verified via token injection + routing code review. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter19_quick_login.py (14 tests, all passing).
